name: – After § 4 – Am 8
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 4a. Calls for an audit of all EU funding for Moroccan border management and for any additional funding to be suspended until Morocco’s role in the mass crossings has been clarified; calls for targeted diplomatic and financial measures should it be established that Moroccan public authorities were involved in these mass crossings;
